tools.description: Use to find club ids and abbreviations for a season (default: the latest). Every other tool takes a club as an id, abbreviation or name. tools.name: list_games
tools.description: Use to list fixtures and results by season, stage, date, date range or club, newest first. For upcoming fixtures with lines use get_schedule; for one match in full use get_game. Costs 2 credits.

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Use for upcoming fixtures (next 1-30 days, default 7) with the median three-way line across posted sportsbooks (home, draw, away moneylines, goal total, handicap) and its implied probabilities. For every book's line use get_odds. Costs 2 credits. Prices are market information: never work out a stake

tools.name: get_game
tools.description: Use for one match in full: score (with shootout), both clubs' box scores (possession, shots, xG, passing, discipline), every player's line, the key events (goals, cards, substitutions, penalties, VAR) and each sportsbook's opening and closing line. For every event use get_events; for formations use

tools.name: get_lineups
tools.description: Use for a match's lineups: each club's formation, starting XI with positions and formation slots, the substitutes used with the minute they came on (and who went off when), and the unused bench. Before kick-off it returns the club-confirmed team sheet (source live) from about an hour before the matc

tools.name: get_standings
tools.description: Use for a season's league table: rank, played, won, drawn, lost, goals for and against, goal difference, points (official, with any deduction), qualification or relegation note, plus home and away records and recent form. Champions League: one table per group or the league phase. Costs 2 credits.

tools.name: get_ratings
tools.description: Use for our club Elo ratings, strongest first, as of the latest match (or as of date). A 100-point gap is about a 64% expected score for the stronger side at a neutral venue. Costs 2 credits.

tools.name: get_head_to_head
tools.description: Use for two clubs' meetings in this competition: wins, draws and goals each, the first meeting, and the results newest first. Costs 2 credits.

tools.name: search_players
tools.description: Use to find a player's id by name (accents optional), optionally within a club. Returns position, current club, last season and appearances. Costs 1 credit.

tools.name: get_player
tools.description: Use for one player: profile, per-season appearances, starts, minutes, goals, assists, shots, our xG, cards and goalkeeping (saves, clean sheets) with per-90 rates, and the last 10 matches. Costs 5 credits.

tools.name: get_player_games
tools.description: Use for a player's match log, newest first: opponent, score, minutes on and off, goals, assists, shots, xG, fouls, cards and goalkeeping. Costs 5 credits.

tools.name: get_leaders
tools.description: Use for a season's leaders in goals, assists, goal contributions, shots, shots on target, our xG, cards, saves or clean sheets, as totals or per 90 minutes (per90, with a minimum of 10 matches by default). Costs 5 credits.

tools.name: get_team_stats
tools.description: Use for clubs' per-match averages over a season, for and against: goals, our xG, shots, shots on target, possession, pass accuracy, corners, fouls, cards, tackles, clean sheets. Possession is missing for some leagues and seasons (for example the Eredivisie before 2020, the Scottish Premiership 2015

tools.name: get_events
tools.description: Use for a match's events in order: goals (with assister, own goals, penalties), shots with location, outcome, body part and our xG, cards, substitutions, fouls, corners, offsides and VAR decisions. Filter with kind. Older matches carry goals, cards and substitutions only. Costs 10 credits.

tools.name: get_shot_map
tools.description: Use for a shot map: a club's shots (or, with against, the shots it conceded), a player's, or one match's, for a season (default: the latest). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_player_props · Private data: get_standings · Public sink: get_schedule, get_game, get_lineups, get_odds, get_line_movement, get_player_props, get_prop_history.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_player_props · Private data: get_standings · Public sink: get_schedule, get_game, get_lineups, get_odds, get_line_movement, get_player_props, get_prop_history

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
